blocks.html: Biocell Stem Cell Science Face Treatment

Uses Microspears to bring about skin peeling while delivering premium active ingredients for healthy skin renewal.
Improves pigmentation, wrinkles, elasticity, acne, and pore size.

An anti-aging facial that uses naturally derived Microspears to bring about skin renewal with remarkable improvements in wrinkles, elasticity, skin tone, acne and pore reduction.

This treatment promotes skin’s natural re-birth for a younger, clearer and firmer appearance. The key ingredient: Microspear, is a spicule which induces skin regeneration to maximize the anti-aging effect. It is naturally derived, and able to stimulate skin renewal at deeper layers. Your old skin gradually sheds, and new younger skin grows back healthier and more youthful, thanks to the infusion of powerful active ingredients that supports healthy skin growth.

  • Generous amounts of natural and powerful active ingredients used in this facial treatment.
  • Pure ingredients are used. Microspears go through 13 purification processes to produce a safe skin regeneration system with uniform particles.

Skin Renewal with Microspears

  • Bioactive microspears are massaged into skin to provoke growth of healthy young cells and collagen.
  • While a high concentration of active ingredients are used to nourish cells, increasing collagen, elastin and hyaluronic acid – the building blocks of supple, radiant skin.
  • As microspears penetrate the skin, it stimulates the skin for up to 72hours, activating circulation and regeneration. You would experience gradual shedding of dead skin cells to reveal younger skin.
  • A Calming Complex that contains 5 TCM herbal plants reduces inflammation and soothes your skin, while your skin is being stimulated to regenerate new cells.

Skin Nourishment

  • A series of high quality active ingredients are massaged into your skin, providing the nutrients for healthy regeneration.
  • Contains Oriental Newplex – a blend of powerful antioxidant fruits.
  • Contains Fresh Bud 6 – a blend of powerful vegetables providing phytonutrients.
  • Contains Adenosine, Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid, Lotus Stem Cell, Edelweiss Callus Stem Cell, 3 Growth Factors, Centella Asiatica, Amino Acid Complex, Beta Glucan.
